notes.title: Small update to version 0.4.1
notes.content:
Small update to version 0.4.1 

Changelog:

1) It's now possible to turn the visibility of the In-Game-Timer on or off. Under "Options --> AUDIO / GAME" Settings. The time is still running in the background though for achievements.

2) "Select Game" option was removed to have faster access to the game.
